scope: Post-input coverage diagnosis; no strategy performance or revised protocol execution

sources.fact: 2017 Appendix B defines active Gold months as February, April, June, August, December; excludes spot month and October.
sources.inference: The frozen every-even-month selection includes listed October contracts outside that historical active sequence. This does not prove why every missing minute is absent.

sources.fact: 2021 guide lists October GC but omits October from the active TAS/TAM month sets.

2016 Treasury calendar-spread study describes migration near the delivery-month boundary; its nine-exchange-day roll window ends on the first business day of the delivery month. August 25, 2016 is a TN peak-roll example.
sources.inference: A child-driven early roll can precede peak migration. Calendar-spread liquidity does not guarantee an exact-minute outright trade.

sources.fact: Historical statistics supports settlement stat_type=3, rtype=24, scaled price and update_action.
sources.limitation: A schema is not evidence of complete usable settlement history.

sources.fact: CME settlements may have preliminary/final updates. ts_ref is the trading-session date, ts_event the venue event, ts_recv capture receipt. No MDP settlement is published without open interest or volume.
sources.limitation: A causal revision must preserve updates and forbid eventual final prices unavailable at the decision cutoff.

sources.fact: Overall dataset starts June 6, 2010; schema-specific availability can differ. Data before May 21, 2017 has no capture timestamps.
Per IP historical service permits 100 concurrent connections and 20 metadata requests/sec; current collector uses 16 workers and a shared 10 starts/sec limiter.
